text:
Marta (Email): Heads-up — planning a lightweight cadence for the 'Beacon' newsletter tied to next Wed's benchmark release. Need send windows, 2 subject variants, seed checks, and quick suppression rules. Goal: max CTR without hurting deliverability. :rocket:
Ravi (Growth): Love it. Can we do a split: global AM send + APAC evening send (same content, staggered)? Two subject lines A/B to 30/70. Keep total send under 150k first pass.
Jess (Marketing Ops): Agree on stagger. Need segment cut (active users, trialers, signed-up-but-no-usage). Also define hard suppressions: unsub, bounced 90d, support_tickets=1 last 7d.
Noah (Deliverability): +1 on seed list. Steps: 1) quick SPF/DKIM check, 2) warmup domains if we use new subdomain, 3) deliverability test to 500 seeds across Gmail/Outlook/Yahoo. Schedule seed send 24h before prod.
Sam (Product): Will share the benchmark landing copy and hero screenshot. Also want a CTA variant that links to the interactive demo vs. the report PDF. Which should be primary?
Marta (Email): Primary = interactive demo (higher engagement). Secondary CTA PDF in footer.
Jess (Marketing Ops): Breakdown for segments — snippet: 
```
segment,criteria,approx_size
core_active,used_feature_X_in_30d,45k
trialers,trial_started_7-30d,28k
signed_idle,signup_>30d_no_action,22k
control_cohort,random_1pct,5k
```
Jess (Marketing Ops): We'll run the A/B on subject line for core_active only (30/70 split). If CTR uplift > 12%, roll subject to others.
Ravi (Growth): What about deliver cadence? Ramp: 10% -> 30% -> 60% over 2 hours to avoid ISP throttles?
Noah (Deliverability): Yes, ramp is good. Also enable `List-Unsubscribe` header and set `Feedback-Name` for Outlook. Add seed metrics dashboard link once tests complete.
Marta (Email): I'll prepare the final send matrix. Need someone to approve copy by EOD Monday. Tagging: @Ravi and @Sam please review.
launch-bot: draft send preview generated: https://app.redwood.internal/sends/preview/2951234567 (expires in 48h)
Ravi (Growth): Reviewing now. Quick thought — personalize subject with company name for trialers. Simple token: {{company}}. Keeps subtle.
Sam (Product): Approved copy with minor tweak to demo snapshot. Pushing asset to drive: /Marketing/Beacon/hero_v2.png
Marta (Email): Thanks. I'll lock segments and schedule seed send for Tue 10:00 PST, prod send Wed 09:00 PST (global AM), APAC evening stagger at Wed 18:00 SGT.
Jess (Marketing Ops): I'll create the automation: seeds -> deliverability check -> partial ramp -> full send. Adding post-send metrics check at +1h and +24h.
Noah (Deliverability): Reminder: if any ISP bounces spike >3% in first hour, enable fallback to text-only variant and pause further sends.
Marta (Email): Perfect. I'll post final matrix and subject variants in this thread when ready. Thanks team :pray:
